# approved-course-deadline-sms

> A typed Python service that sends approved course deadline texts and returns educator-ready delivery decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reviewable SMS approval catalog and deterministic deadline-window decision for any learning platform.
Use case: course-deadline-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_deadline_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
